claims: Vaccines prevent millions of deaths annually.
Live-attenuated vaccines use a weakened form of the virus or bacteria.
Inactivated vaccines use a killed version of the germ.
The polio vaccine is an inactivated vaccine.
Subunit/recombinant/conjugate vaccines use specific pieces of the germ such as its protein or shell.
Toxoid vaccines use toxins made by the germ to create immunity to the disease rather than the germ itself.
MRNA vaccines provide instructions for cells to make a protein that triggers an immune response.
The HPV vaccine prevents certain types of cancer.
Routine childhood vaccinations are generally started at birth.
Tdap is a vaccine against tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis.
Vaccines are available through pediatricians, family doctors, public health clinics, and many pharmacies.
